summary: Today presents a mixed legal and corporate briefing driven by High Court rulings on compliance NOCs and corporate governance disputes alongside major retail developments. Statutory approval rules from the Kerala High Court and Reliance's massive Rs 10 lakh crore AI investment plan anchor today's priorities for legal counsel.

bullets.text: The Kerala High Court ruled that revised petrol pump site plans require fresh ADM NOCs, holding PESO approval alone is legally insufficient.
Tata Trusts filed lawsuits in the Bombay High Court challenging N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment as chairman.
Mukesh Ambani announced Reliance and Jio will invest Rs 10 lakh crore over seven years to drive India’s AI transformation.
P&G Home reported a 2.7% drop in FY26 net profit to Rs 664.8 crore, despite total revenue rising 3.4% to Rs 9,359.34 crore.
Silver and gold jewellery brand GIVA secured Rs 90 crore from BlackSoil to fund its nationwide offline retail network expansion.
